schema_compliance.notes: All 5 pipeline files present (research.json, resolution.json, materials.json, sop_modules.json, production.json). Required top-level keys present in all files. spec_family_id = SF_TRIM_INT_RP across all files.

task_id_threading.notes: All 40 task IDs match exactly between sop_modules.json and production.json. No orphan tasks in either direction. 35 TSK_TMRP_* tasks + 5 TSK_RRP_* shared tasks.

paintscope_readiness.notes: 20 PaintScope keys declared in resolution.json. All required_input_key and paintscope_key references in production.json map to declared keys. 9 surface LF keys, 3 protection keys, 1 edge key, 7 meta/enum keys.

uom_alignment.notes: All unit_of_measure values are uppercase and valid per controlled_enums.json. LF (primary), SF, EA, EA_ROOM, FIXED all used correctly. No lowercase units found.

prefix_compliance.notes: All spec-owned tasks use TSK_TMRP_* prefix. All spec-owned modules use MOD_TMRP_* prefix. No TSK_TRIM_*, TSK_SETUP_*, TSK_WLRP_*, TSK_CLRP_* reuse. Shared RRP module uses TSK_RRP_* (correct — not owned by this spec). CON_ prefix used for all consumables (no CONS_).

enum_validation.notes: All quality_tier values QT3-QT5 (no QT2 — correct for trim). All substrate_state values are valid SS_INT_* values. All phase values valid (setup, prep, prime, interstage, finish, cleanup). All task_classification values valid (binary, qt_scaled — no qt_conditional in this spec). All sheen values valid (satin, semi-gloss, gloss — no compounds). All severity values use critical/major/minor (no high/medium/low). task_classification key used throughout (no task_class).

modifier_stacking.notes: Stacking partition correctly enforced. Prep pool: condition x height x profile_complexity (max 4.20x at POOR/H3/Ornate — slightly over 4.0x flag, flagged for estimator review). Coating pool: QT x height x profile_complexity (max 3.15x). Pools never cross-apply. condition never in coating pool, QT never in prep pool.

rate_reasonableness.notes: Core LF application rates within 30-300 range: brush prime 90, brush finish 80-90, scrape 45, feather 80, caulk 80, degloss 160. Spray rates 375-445 LF/hr reasonable for airless spray on trim. Inspection/cleanup tasks above 300 LF/hr acceptable (visual scan, dust wipe). All rate_range_low <= rate <= rate_range_high. Fixed-time tasks 4-30 minutes per room — reasonable.

rp_specific_checks.notes: Assessment module present with 4 tasks (ASSESS_CONDITION, ASSESS_ADHESION, ASSESS_COATING_ID, ASSESS_MOISTURE). State-driven primer selection with 3 systems (adhesion, stain-block, mildew). No bare-wood NC tasks (no fill_fasteners, fill_end_grain, mdf_edge_seal, spot_prime_knots). Furniture protection (TSK_TMRP_FURNITURE_CLEAR + TSK_TMRP_FURNITURE_RESTORE) and customer walkthrough (TSK_TMRP_CUSTOMER_WALKTHROUGH) present.

round_configuration_integrity.notes: 4 round configurations defined in sop_modules.json: ROUND_TMRP_PRIME_2FINISH (QT3-4 FAIR/POOR), ROUND_TMRP_PRIME_3FINISH (QT5 brush FAIR/POOR), ROUND_TMRP_2FINISH (QT3-4 GOOD), ROUND_TMRP_3FINISH (QT5 brush GOOD). All referenced in production.json. Phase sequences correctly ordered. 3rd coat handled by re-running finish phase tasks per phase_sequence (standard pattern). QT5 brush 3-coat per FFD 15.10.3.

material_system_consistency.notes: 6 material systems: 3 state-driven primers (SYS_PRIMER_ADHESION_INT, SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT, SYS_PRIMER_MILDEW_INT) + 3 QT-driven fine-finish systems (SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC/QT3, SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE/QT4, SYS_FF_PREMIUM/QT5). All system IDs consistent across materials.json and resolution.json. Primer applies_when substrate_state values are valid SS_INT_* values.

protection_zone_threading.notes: 4 zones declared in resolution.json (floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent, fixture_covers, furniture_room). All 4 referenced in sop_modules.json task protection_metadata. Setup tasks for all zones present. Teardown tasks present in cleanup module.

cross_file_integrity.details: Fine-finish systems map to QT3, QT4, QT5. Primer systems map by substrate_state. All tiers within spec's QT3-QT5 range.
All paintscope_key references in production.json exist in resolution.json paintscope_keys.
4 zones match: floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent, fixture_covers, furniture_room.
Phases in order: setup, prep, prep (RRP), prep (TMRP_PREP), prime, interstage, finish, cleanup. Multiple prep-phase modules correctly ordered after setup.

cross_file_integrity.check: Rule 9: TSK_ context prefix from resolution
cross_file_integrity.details: Resolution declares TSK_TMRP_* prefix. All 35 spec-owned tasks use TSK_TMRP_*. 5 shared TSK_RRP_* tasks are from shared module MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT (not spec-owned).

cross_file_integrity.check: Rule 10: ITM_ existing IDs exact match
cross_file_integrity.details: All 9 ITM_ IDs in resolution marked 'existing' and reuse exact registered IDs (ITM_TRIM_BASEBOARD, ITM_TRIM_CROWN, etc.).

cross_file_integrity.check: Rule 11: Downstream agents used only resolution enum values
cross_file_integrity.details: All enum values in sop_modules.json, production.json, and materials.json are within resolution.json applicable_enums scope.

doctrine_compliance.details: QT3 minimum for trim enforced (no QT2). FFD 15.10.3 implemented via QT5 brush 3-coat round configs. Fine-finish systems (SYS_FF_*) correctly mapped to tiers. Interstage inspection and sanding present.
Wall masking always required in RP (walls are finished). Floor perimeter protection always required. Fixture covers conditional on spray method. Furniture protection conditional on occupancy.

Stacking partition enforced — prep pool and coating pool never overlap. Profile complexity modifier applied consistently. Height modifier applied to all tasks. Worst-case prep 4.20x flagged for estimator review.
All required sections present: protection zones, adjacency declarations, state declarations, site condition rules, configuration dimensions, variants, PaintScope inputs.

warnings.message: 9 tasks missing optional task_type field (4 assessment tasks + 5 RRP shared tasks). task_type is optional per structural_keys.json but recommended for filtering.
warnings.recommendation: Add task_type: 'inspect' to assessment tasks and appropriate task_type values to RRP tasks in a future update.

warnings.message: Prep pool maximum modifier stack 4.20x (POOR 2.0 x H3 1.5 x Ornate 1.40) slightly exceeds 4.0x flag threshold. This is a real-world scenario (poor condition ornate crown in tall space).
warnings.recommendation: Flag for estimator review when all three conditions co-occur. No rate adjustment needed — the stack is correct per doctrine.

warnings.message: production.json uses 'fixed_minutes' field name instead of structural_keys.json canonical 'fixed_time_minutes'. This matches the wall RP precedent (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP_v1) and is consistent within RP specs.
warnings.recommendation: Accept as-is for RP spec consistency. Consider formalizing 'fixed_minutes' as accepted synonym in structural_keys.json.

registry_additions_escalated.description: Registry additions proposed in resolution.json that require id_registry.json updates before spec activation.
registry_additions_escalated.notes: Many proposed items are shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (first interior RP spec). Shared items: PS_META.SURFACE_CONDITION, PS_PROTECT_SF.FURNITURE_ROOM, PS_META.ENUM.SUBSTRATE_STATE_INT, PS_META.BOOL.HOME_PRE_1978, PS_META.ENUM.CONTAMINATION_TYPE, and corresponding IN_ inputs. New to this spec: PS_META.PROFILE_COMPLEXITY, IN_ENUM_PROFILE_COMPLEXITY, CON_DEGLOSS_LIQUID, CON_SCRAPER_CONTOUR, CON_SANDING_SPONGE_CONTOUR.

summary: SF_TRIM_INT_RP_v1 passes all validation gates with no issues. 40 tasks across 8 modules (7 TMRP-owned + 1 shared RRP). 6 material systems (3 state-driven primers + 3 QT-driven fine-finish). 4 round configurations covering QT3-QT5 x brush/spray x GOOD/FAIR/POOR. 4 protection zones. 20 PaintScope inputs. 9 paintable items (all existing trim types). Profile complexity modifier correctly inherited from NC trim. Assessment phase present with 4 tasks. No bare-wood NC tasks. Furniture protection and customer walkthrough present. 3 minor warnings documented (missing optional task_type, 4.20x stack flag, fixed_minutes field name). Ready for spec.json assembly.
